---
title: bc.raw
---
## Broadcasted Operations on Raw Arrays {.unnumbered}


### Description

The <code>bc.raw()</code> function
performs broadcasted (in)equality operations and bit-wise operations
on arrays of type <code>raw</code>. <br />
<br />



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>bc.raw(x, y, op)
</code></pre>


### Arguments

<table>
<tr><td style = "white-space: collapse; font-family: monospace; vertical-align: top"><code id="x">x</code>, <code id="y">y</code></td>
<td>
conformable raw vectors or arrays.
</td></tr>
<tr><td style = "white-space: collapse; font-family: monospace; vertical-align: top"><code id="op">op</code></td>
<td>
a single string, giving the operator. <br />
Supported bit-wise operators: &amp;, |. <br />
Supported relational operators: ==, !=, &lt;, &gt;, &lt;=, &gt;=. <br />
Supported basic arithmetic operators (see details section for more info): +, -, *, pmin, pmax. <br />
<br />
</td></tr>
</table>


### Details

The basic arithmetic operators treat the <code>raw</code> type as unsigned 8-bit integers without missing value support. <br />
The unsigned 8-bit integer supports values from 0 to 255. <br />
Using the raw type as 8-bit integers may be useful when
dealing with <b>very</b> large arrays filled with small non-negative integers: <br />
The <code>raw</code> type takes in 4 times less memory than 32-bit integers,
and 8 times less memory than 53-bit integers and doubles. <br />
<br />
Overflow is handled in the same way as it is handled in pure 'C' code. <br />
For example, <code>as.raw(255) + as.raw(2)</code> equals <code>as.raw(1)</code>. <br />
<br />



### Value

For bit-wise operators: <br />
A array of type <code>raw</code>,
as a result of the broadcasted bit-wise operation. <br />
<br />
For relational operators: <br />
A logical array as a result of the broadcasted integer relational comparison. <br />
<br />
For the basic arithmetic operators: <br />
A array of type <code>raw</code>,
as a result of the broadcasted basic arithmetic operation. <br />
<br />



### Examples
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=TRUE, collapse = TRUE, comment = NA}
library("broadcast")

x.dim <- c(4:2)
x.len <- prod(x.dim)
x.data <- as.raw(0:10)
y.data <- as.raw(10:0)
x <- array(x.data, x.dim)
y <- array(y.data, c(4,1,1))

bc.raw(x, y, "==")
bc.raw(x, y, "!=")

bc.raw(x, y, "&")
bc.raw(x, y, "|")


```
